name: LegalOS – eCourts Cause List Intelligence: AI Hearing Prep, Clash Detection & Outcome Logging

parameters.content:
## ⚖️ LegalOS – eCourts Cause List Intelligence

For litigation firms and solo advocates in India who still check cause lists by hand every evening, and find out about a clash or a missing listing only at the court gate.

### How it works
Every evening the workflow downloads tomorrow's cause lists for each court you follow, reads the PDF or HTML, and finds your cases in them. It estimates when each matter will be called and flags clashes when one advocate is listed in two halls at once. Cases you expected but can't find are flagged for a manual check.

For each listed matter, an AI agent reads past hearings and case notes and sends the advocate a short brief on WhatsApp or Telegram. The partner gets the full board. At 8:30 AM each advocate gets their day in call order, and after court a short form logs the outcome and next date back into the case diary.

### Setup steps
1. Create a Google Sheet with **Cases**, **Court Sources**, **Hearing Log** and **Case Notes** tabs. Add each court's cause-list URL pattern to Court Sources.
2. Connect Google Sheets, OpenAI, Telegram and WhatsApp Business Cloud.
3. Replace the `REPLACE_WITH_…` values, including the Telegram chat IDs and n8n base URL in **Compute Next Hearing Date & Config**.
4. Add one real case, run the evening flow manually, then activate.

## 📅 Hearing Date & Sources
Every evening at 7 PM IST, works out the next court day (skipping Sunday), then loads your active cases and the cause-list URL for each court.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Fetch & Extract Cause Lists

parameters.content:
## 📥 Fetch & Extract Cause Lists
Downloads each court's cause list and pulls the text out of PDF or HTML. If a court site is down, the admin hears about it on Telegram rather than the run quietly missing a court.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Match, Dedupe & Clash Check

parameters.content:
## 🔍 Match, Dedupe & Clash Check
Finds each case in the cause lists, estimates call time from the item number and flags clashes when one advocate is listed in two halls at once. The partner gets the full board, and cases already reminded are skipped.

## 🧠 AI Hearing Prep
For each listed matter, the agent reads the last few hearings and internal case notes, then writes a short brief: where things stand, what's likely today and what to carry.

## ⚠️ Not Listed Alerts
A case you expected but can't find in tomorrow's list is flagged for a manual check on eCourts.

## 📲 Log & Send Reminders
Saves the hearing to the log, updates the case record, and sends the advocate their brief on WhatsApp or Telegram, with a short pause between messages.

## ☀️ Morning Day Boards
At 8:30 AM on court days, each advocate gets one message listing their matters for the day in call order, with halls and estimated times.

## ✅ Hearing Outcome Logging
After court, the advocate logs the outcome and next date through a short form. The hearing log and case diary are updated, so tomorrow's brief has the latest history.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Case data is confidential, so keep the sheet private and store all tokens as n8n credentials. Turn on basic auth for the outcome form so only your team can log hearings. Be gentle with court sites and keep one fetch per court per day.

nodes.name: Dedupe, Estimate Call Time & Detect Clashes

options.systemMessage:
You are a diligent litigation associate at an Indian law firm preparing the advocate for tomorrow's hearing.
1. Call the "Hearing History" tool with the case_id to recap the last 1-3 hearings (outcomes, next-date reasons, order summaries).
2. Call the "Case Notes" tool with the case_id for internal notes (pending filings, client instructions, deadlines).
3. Work out the likely purpose of this listing from the stage and the history.
4. Produce at most 4 concrete preparation items (documents, compliance, arguments, instructions to seek).
5. If there is a clash, suggest one practical step (pass-over request, proxy counsel, mentioning).
Never invent orders, dates or facts. If history is empty, say "first listing on record". Be brief, because this goes to WhatsApp.

parameters.toolDescription: Returns all logged hearings for a case (hearing_date, stage, outcome, next_date, order_summary). Input: case_id.
Returns internal case notes (note_date, note) for a case: pending filings, client instructions, deadlines. Input: case_id.
